_about: The classic claim map: which control a point of the view is on, every 4th unit, at 16:9 and 4:3, at several ticks of a level's age, clear-portals hidden and shown. Recorded by `test_mp test_mp_layer --record-golden` on the CLASSIC claim and HUD code as it stood at commit 3926faf (planning step 178, CTL-2), where the only production change is the two test seams ControlAt and PlaceCameraForTest, before the controls were refactored (CTL-3). EXTENDED ONCE, before CTL-3 began and on the same unmodified claim code, by the states a review found missing (a level younger than 700 ms with clear-portals shown, the pads mid-slide, the door tick): the entries recorded first (14 claim, 138 HUD) kept their values byte for byte. A golden is never re-recorded to make a refactor pass: if the classic path really changed on purpose, the step says so and records why. Hashes are FNV-1a over float bits and picture file names; no pixel and no Asantee byte is here.
